## Standing operator rules
- Always run `make license-check` from the repository root after changing `requirements/base.txt`.
- Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
- Never create a service-specific Google Cloud NAT gateway for ledgerly; use the gateway named ledgerly-shared-prod-nat instead.

## Current objective
Add a CSV vendor-credit importer at `ledgerly/imports/vendor_credits.py`. SQLAlchemy 2.0 upgrade and `acme-utils` release are paused. Current indexing optimization work is recent groundwork.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Staging Redis: `redis://cache-eu-3:6379`; `cache-eu-1` is superseded/draining.
- `self.worker.pending_events.extend(list(batch))`; `extend(batch)` is superseded.
- `_last_batch` is removed.
- `_add_billing_filters(parser)` sets `dest="currency"`.
- Search embedding: `ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8)`, `CHUNK_SIZE = 100`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- SQLAlchemy pool size 50 caused staging contention/deadlocks; never retry.
- Copying batches alone failed because `BillingWorker._last_batch` retained the list.
- Shared currency helper requires explicit `dest`.
- Retrying all `HTTPStatusError` values incorrectly retried 4xx responses; retry only `httpx.TransportError` and retryable server responses.

## Recent work
Webhook retries and search rebuild concurrency/chunking were completed and tested. Search rebuild improved from 8.42s to 1.87s locally. PostgreSQL selected `invoices_tenant_updated_idx` when `tenant_id` was present. Two pre-existing `tests/search/test_index.py` failures concerned recently updated descriptions; rebuild/index suites later passed 33 tests.
